task: pMap never settles when its source is an async iterator such as a queue that blocks in next() once exhausted. After the source has reported done, pMap still calls next() again as each mapper finishes, so the returned promise hangs forever. Once the source has reported done, pMap should not request more items from it and should resolve with the results.
setup: npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock ava@^5.2.0 chalk@^5.3.0 delay@^6.0.0 in-range@^3.0.0 random-int@^3.0.0 time-span@^5.1.0
